name: list-wip
description: List files changed on the current pull request, relative to its base branch, optionally filtered by path and extension.

LIST_PATHS.description: Comma-separated list of paths to restrict the list to. Defaults to `.` (whole repository).

LIST_EXTENSIONS.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to keep, without the leading dot. Defaults to `php`.

LIST_BASE_REF.description: Base branch/ref to diff against. Defaults to `GITHUB_BASE_REF`, which GitHub Actions sets automatically on `pull_request` events.

files.description: Newline-separated list of matching changed files. Empty when none match.

has-files.description: true if at least one file matches, false otherwise.
